records.c: object type 3, the hidden prize block: four sprites in a square, unseen ($B7, an empty shape) until shot. The first hit shows it ($98-$9B); then it holds the hero up like a floor and blocks his head, and jumping into it from below bumps it up and down. Twenty more hits burst it: every object slot, enemies and all, becomes one of eleven prizes that fly out and turn into bonus symbols

its first frame: three more free slots for the other quarters (none: it is removed), each type 3, white, unseen, 0 or 12 units right and 0 or 21 lines down of the first, which keeps state 1; 20 hits to burst ($BE06), no bump going
the other quarters (state 0) do nothing of their own; the prizes (state 3) fly at $7646
the first quarter places the other three round it each frame; on the screen it looks for the hero's shots over the whole square ($7663)
hit while unseen (state 1): it shows (state 2, shapes $98 to $9B)
hit when shown: every quarter flashes black with the sound $98, and the twentieth hit bursts it ($75AF)
not hit: white again; unseen it does nothing more
shown: the bump goes on ($76B4); then is the hero over it? His feet within 6 lines of its top stand him on it ($0257); his head under it ($0258) starts a bump, without a sound, if none is going
the hero is not at it: its flags cleared

the burst: lets go of the hero, and all eleven slots, 10 down to 0, become prizes (type 3, state 3): each a random kind from the nine at $76ED, near the block's corner, with a random speed of -4 to 3 across and -8 to 7 down, for 3 to 10 frames; the sounds $9A and $8B
the random kind mixes the timer with a byte of the program itself ($7460 on) and the last kind ($BE1B); the ADC at $75EB adds a random 0 or 1 so kinds 0 to 8 can all come up
the ADC's operand: the random 0 or 1, written at $75DB
a prize flies by its speeds ($BDF0, $BDFB) for its frames, then becomes a bonus symbol (type 2)
looks for the hero's shots in the six by five characters under the square: one (a character from $D8 up) becomes $D4 and sets carry
one step of the bump: all four quarters move by the curve at $76D8, read from 8 down: up 6 lines and back
the ADC whose operand $76CB holds the bump's step
the ADC's operand: the bump's Y step, written at $76BF
the bump's Y steps, read from 8 down: -2, -2, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2
the four quarters' first states: 1 for the first, 0 for the other three
the quarters' X from the first: 0, 0, 12, 12
the quarters' Y from the first: 0, 21, 0, 21
the nine prizes' shapes: $8C four times (the weapons and the shield, told apart by colour), $8D P, $8E G, $8F M, $90 L and $8B the 1UP
the nine prizes' colours: red, green, blue and light blue for the four $8C, yellow P, then white

object type 4, the bomb dropper: a pod on the ceiling ($9C, white) that drops a bomb every 32 frames, falling 4 lines a frame until it hits a wall or the hero. Some are unseen (placed with state 1, shape $FE) and drop bombs of another shape ($9E for $9D). Shot, it explodes with 200 points
its first frame: shape by state ($7801), white, the first bomb in 7 to 31 frames, a unit right
the bombs (state 1) fall at $778E
every 32 frames, unless it is low on the screen, a bomb (type 4, state 1, yellow) from 2 units right and 8 lines down, with the sound $81
a bomb: below the top of the play area, the character under it is looked at; a wall sets it off
touches the hero? He is hurt; shielded, the bomb goes off
the bomb falls 4 lines a frame; past Y 220 it is removed
the dropper's shape by state: $9C drawn, $FE unseen

object type 5, the spiked crusher: a spiked bar of two sprites side by side ($B8, $B9) that hangs still until the hero passes under it, then drops 4 lines a frame until it lands on a wall, with the sound $A3, and stays there. It takes 100 energy of shots; destroyed, both halves explode with 500 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it for the same points
its first frame: a free slot for the right half (none: it is removed), type 5 state 1, 12 units right; both white; 100 energy ($BE32), not yet dropping ($BE3D)
the right half (state 1) does nothing of its own
the left half: keeps the right one beside it, and looks for shots at itself only
destroyed: both halves explode, with 500 points
hit: the weapon's damage off its energy; both halves flash black with the sound $98
touches the hero? He is hurt, but shielded or as the wheel he destroys it
off the screen it is removed ($7949)
the hero within 25 units left to 8 right of it sets it dropping ($BE3D = 1) on the next frame
dropping: the character two rows under it; a wall lands it ($BE3D = 2) with the sound $A3, otherwise it falls 4 lines, both halves
both halves removed, without an explosion

object type 6, the fire-spitting giant: two sprites, a yellow head ($C8-$D5) over grey legs ($C6, $C7, $D6-$E3), that walks a unit a frame for 50 steps or to the end of its floor, then stands, turns to face the hero and spits a spinning fire bar ($E4-$EB, cyan) every 22 frames for as long as it lives. The bars fly 2 units a frame in an arc and burst on walls. It takes 40 energy of shots; destroyed, it bursts into eleven pieces of debris with 1,000 points. Touching it or a bar hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it for the same points

its first frame: its direction from its state ($BE53); a free slot for the legs (none: it is removed), type 6 state 0, grey, 21 lines below; the head state 1, yellow; shapes by direction ($7CFC, $7CFE); 40 energy, 50 steps, the walking frames at 6
the legs (state 0) do nothing of their own; a bar (state 3) flies at $7B7B and the debris (state 4) at $7CAB
the head: both parts their own colours again; hit, the weapon's damage off its energy, and both flash white with the sound $8B
touches the hero? He is hurt, but shielded or as the wheel he destroys the giant
off the screen both parts explode out of sight

walking (state 1): every 3 frames the next of seven frames for head and legs by direction ($7D00-$7D15), a unit along; when the character under its feet ahead is open, or its 50 steps are done, it stops (state 2)
stops: state 2, its legs standing ($7CFE)

standing (state 2): faces the hero; every 2 frames one of ten frames of the head spitting ($7D1C, $7D27), and at the sixth a bar: a free slot becomes type 6 state 3, cyan, drawn in hi-res, from its mouth, with its own frame and a random start in the arc, and the sound $88

a fire bar: touches the hero? He is hurt; shielded or the wheel, the bar bursts. It flies 2 units a frame ($7D32) and spins ($7D4A, $7D52), and rises and falls by the curve at $7D5A; it bursts on a wall and is removed off the screen
the bar bursts, back to multicolour
destroyed: both parts explode, and every free slot becomes a piece of debris (type 6, state 4, $EC or $ED, grey) near it, with a random odd speed of -3 to 3 across and -7 to 7 down, and 1,000 points
a piece of debris flies by its speeds ($7D8E, $7D99) until it hits a wall or leaves the play area
the head's shape by direction: $C8 left, $CE right
the legs' standing shape by direction: $C6 left, $C7 right
the head's frames walking left, read from 6 down
the legs' frames walking left, read from 6 down
the head's frames walking right, read from 6 down
the legs' frames walking right, read from 6 down
the head's frames spitting to the left, read from 9 down: the mouth opens and shuts; the eleventh, at 10, is never read
the head's frames spitting to the right, read from 9 down
a bar's X step by direction: -2, 2
each slot's spinning frame, eleven bytes, kept here as the game runs
each slot's place in the arc, eleven bytes, starting at a random 0 to 15
the bar's eight spinning frames flying left: $E4 to $EB
the bar's spinning frames flying right: $EB down to $E4
the bar's Y step by its place in the arc: up 5 lines a frame at first, slowing, then down up to 2 lines a frame; it holds at the last
each slot's X speed as debris, eleven bytes, kept here as the game runs
each slot's Y speed as debris, eleven bytes

object type 7, the spiked ball ($A0-$A3, white): rolls 1 unit a frame towards where the hero was when it appeared and bounces along the floor, turning at walls with the sound $8B. Shot, it splits into two small balls ($A4) thrown up and out at random, and explodes with 400 points; a small ball shot is gone for the same points. Touching either hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it
its first frame: state 0, rolling frame 0, a frame every 4, at the top of a bounce (11), heading towards the hero
shot: a big ball (state 0) throws out two small ones first
each small ball: a free slot, searched from 10 down, type 7 state 1, white, $A4, 4 units right and 10 lines up, a random height in the bounce (21 to 28) and a random speed of -4 to 3 across
the LDY's operand: the slot just used, so the search goes on below it
the ball explodes, with 400 points
touches the hero? Its box by its size ($7F3C, $7F3E): he is hurt; shielded or as the wheel he destroys it
off the screen it is removed
below the top of the play area: a wall ahead turns it round, with the sound $8B
held within Y 40 to 214: at the top it starts falling, at the bottom it bounces
falling, a wall under it bounces it (the curve from 30), rising, a wall over it sends it down (from 5), each with the sound $8B
moves by its speed and the curve at $7F40, one step further each frame

a big ball steps through its four rolling frames ($A0-$A3) every 4 frames. The step is meant to follow the way it rolls, but the BNE at $7F28 tests for a speed of zero, which the big ball never has, so the frames always run backwards, $A3 to $A0, whichever way it goes
the touch box's height by size: 15 big, 8 small
the touch box's width by size: 6 big, 4 small
the bounce's Y steps, read from the place in it down: up 6 lines a frame at 30, slowing to 0 at 10 to 12, then falling up to 4 lines a frame at 0, where it stays until it lands

object type 8, the hopping gunner ($BC-$C3, white): walks a unit a frame, hopping up when a wall stands in front of it and off the end of a floor, turns at walls, and stops to shoot ($BA, $BB) when the hero comes within 30 units, a bullet every 60 frames. It takes 40 energy of shots and gives 200 points. A grenade's or mine's blast throws it off the screen in a death leap ($C4, $C5), with 200 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it
its first frame: its direction from its state ($BEAB), the shape for it ($81D2), walking frames every 2, state 0, white, 30 frames to the first shot, 40 energy
white again; walking or shooting, a blast ($0305 negative) starts the death leap: state 2, 200 points, $81D4, 12 steps up the curve
hit: the weapon's damage off its energy, and it flashes black with the sound $A2; below zero it explodes ($7FFD) with 200 points
walking or falling: a wall in front of it at its own height starts a hop ($BEB6 = 12)
touches the hero? The gunner hurts him; shielded or as the wheel he destroys it
falling (1) moves on at $8082, the leap (2) at $80E0, shooting (3) at $815D
walking: within 30 units of the hero it stops to shoot ($8140); otherwise every 2 frames its next walking frame, with the sound $8E at each fourth
a wall ahead turns it round
on the play area: the character under its feet; a floor stands it there (state 0, snapped to the character row, $8101); none starts a fall (state 1) with a small hop
moves up or down by the hop curve at $81C5, one step on each frame; held below Y 29; past Y 250 it is gone
moves a unit its way; leaving the screen it is removed
removed: slot freed, back to multicolour, X 0 and Y 250
sets its state: 3 (shoot) when the hero is within 30 units across, 0 (walk) otherwise; returns it in Y

shooting: faces the hero ($BA right, $BB left); every 60 frames a bullet (type 18, $93) from 4 units right and 8 lines down, a unit a frame across ($81D6) and a line a frame towards his height, with the sound $99; a blast starts the death leap
the hop's Y steps, read from 12 down: up 5 lines a frame, slowing, then down up to 4 lines a frame, where it stays until it lands
the first walking shape by direction: $C0 left, $BC right
the death leap's shape by direction: $C5 left, $C4 right
its bullet's X step by its shape less $BA: 1 right, -1 left

object type 9, the sliding block (sprite $9F, white): sits still until shot, then slides 3 units a frame away from the hero, turning round at walls with the sound $A3, until it leaves the screen. Nothing destroys it, and touching it hurts the hero unless he is shielded or the wheel
its first frame: still (state 0), white, shape $9F
the first shot sets it sliding away from the hero (state 1), with the sound $98; later shots do nothing
touches the hero? He is hurt unless shielded or the wheel; either way the block stays
sliding: off the screen it is removed; a wall character ahead of it, a row down, turns it round with the sound $A3

object type 10, the dart: waits 31 to 62 frames, then flies off in the direction its state gives (0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right; shapes $A5-$A8) with the sound $83, 4 lines or 2 units a frame, until it hits a wall. Shot three times it explodes with 200 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it
its first frame: its shape by direction, the wait, 3 energy
white again; hit, the weapon's damage off its energy, and it flashes black with the sound $98
destroyed: an explosion and 200 points
touches the hero? The dart hurts him; shielded or as the wheel he destroys it
waiting: when the wait runs out, the sound $83
flying: moves by $8357 and $835B; leaving the play area it is removed, and a wall at its point sets it off
X step by direction: 0, 0, -2, 2
Y step by direction: -4, 4, 0, 0

object type 11, the turret: a gun on the floor (state 0, $A9-$AF) or the ceiling (state 1, $B0-$B6, 4 lines higher) that turns to face the hero, in six frames, and fires a bullet every 60 frames while it is not turning. Shot three times it explodes with 500 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it

its first frame: shape and height by state ($84ED, $84EF), 3 energy, a frame every 4, 60 frames to the first shot, facing the hero's side: set the wrong way round, so that its first frame turns it to him
the hero on the other side from the way it faces: it starts turning ($BF30), six frames
turning: every 4 frames the next of six frames, by floor or ceiling and the way it turns ($84D1-$84E6), read from 5 down
white again; hit, the weapon's damage off its energy, and it flashes black with the sound $A0
destroyed: an explosion and 500 points
touches the hero? The turret hurts him; shielded or as the wheel he destroys it
not turning: every 60 frames a bullet (type 18, $93) from its muzzle ($84F1, $84F3), 2 units a frame the way it faces and -2 to 1 lines a frame at random, with the sound $81
the floor turret's frames turning to the left, read from 5 down: $AE to $A9; the first, $AF, is never shown
the floor turret's frames turning to the right, read from 5 down: $AA to $AF
the ceiling turret's frames turning to the left, read from 5 down: $B5 to $B0
the ceiling turret's frames turning to the right, read from 5 down: $B1 to $B6
the first shape by state: $A9 floor, $B0 ceiling
how far it is raised by state: 0 floor, 4 ceiling
the bullet's X from the turret by the way it faces: -2 left, 10 right
the bullet's Y from the turret by state: 0 floor, 8 ceiling
character $7B as level 3-1 loaded it, 8 bytes, put back at the start ($ACF0): 3-1's end boss rolled it a line a frame and left it wherever it stopped
character $7D as 3-1 loaded it, put back with $7B; its last byte is also entry 0 of the next table, never read
character $7D's last line, $FF, and entry 0 of the parallax table's low bytes, never read since direction 0 means no scroll
the parallax routine for each scroll direction 1 to 8, low bytes: up $AD54, down $AD78, left $ADAA, right $AD9A, and the four diagonals $ADCC, $ADC6, $ADC0, $ADBA
direction 8's low byte, $BA, which is also entry 0 of the high bytes, never read
their high bytes, all $AD; the table starts on the last low byte, at $850C
eleven zeros before the object lists; nothing reads them
